note: The research desk's three bots. Each is a Hermes profile with its own instructions, model and tools. toolsets 'clarify' means no tools at all (coordinating and filing need none); only the researcher reads the web. Two time limits per bot, in seconds: run_budget is soft (at 80% the bot is told to stop looking and write up; it replaces the profile's own budget for desk calls) and timeout is the hard stop above it. Both are long on purpose: a slow complete report beats a fast cut-off one. The caps stop the room and hand it to the owner.
